title: THE MONK - the oriental monk: the ability minima with no prime requisite, the d4 hit-dice doctrine, the ki power, the level-power ladder with the falls and the mind shields, the monastery duel, the material restrictions, Tables 20 and 21
audit_comment: OA round eight (capture pp. 31-35): the monk - the ability minima, the discipline ladders of Tables 20 and 21, the ki power, the level powers, the monastery duel and the material restrictions

banner.title: THE MONK, printed capture pp. 31-35 - the OA monk round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 31-35 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). The Table 20 hit-points column header is settled against the 2018 print (4-sided dice for accum. hit points) - the 2-through-18 cells pin as accumulated d4 dice, the level plus one. The Table 21 additional-attack and additional-damage cells pin as codes (the slash pairs and the plus-dice notation). OCR normalization: may riot own horses reads as may not own horses; immune to gees reads as immune to geas (prose only)

tables.name: dghT20Grid
tables.comment: the Table 20 monk advancement grid (capture pp. 31-32)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 2,250 at 1st to 3,250,000 at 16th, then the 3,250,001 floor of the unbounded 17th (capture pp. 31-32).
the accumulated d4 dice column: the 2d4 start plus 1d4 per level - the level plus one, 2 through 18 (the 2018 print settles the header: 4-sided dice for accum. hit points) (capture pp. 31-32).

the level-title code column: 1 Novice, 2 Initiate, 3 Brother, 4 Disciple, 5 Immaculate, 6 Master, 7 Superior Master, 8 Master of Dragons, 9 Master of the North Wind, 10 Master of the West Wind, 11 Master of the South Wind, 12 Master of the East Wind, 13 Master of Winter, 14 Master of Autumn, 15 Master of Summer, 16 Master of Spring, 17 Grand Master of Flowers (capture pp. 31-32).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 20 grid: the xp bounds, the accumulated d4 dice and the title codes (capture pp. 31-32)

tables.name: dghT21Grid
tables.comment: the Table 21 monk capabilities grid (capture p. 33)
col_comments: the armor class column: 10 at 1st improving to -3 at 17th, the style AC used only if better (capture p. 33).
the movement column: 15 feet at 1st improving to 32 at 17th (capture p. 33).
the additional martial-arts attack column as a code - 0 none, then extra attacks times ten plus the round: 1/4 = 14, 1/2 = 12, 1/1 = 11, 3/2 = 32, 2/1 = 21, 3/1 = 31 (capture p. 33).

the additional martial-arts damage column as a code - dice times 100 plus points: 0 none, 1, 2, then 100 (+1D), 101 (+1D+1), 102 (+1D+2), 200 (+2D), 201 (+2D+1), 300 (+3D), 301 (+3D+1), 400 (+4D) (capture p. 33).
the open locks column: 25 percent at 1st to 99 at 17th (capture p. 33).
the find and remove traps column: 20 percent at 1st to 99 at 17th (capture p. 33).
the move silently column: 15 percent at 1st to 99 at 13th and beyond (capture p. 33).
the hide in shadows column: 10 percent at 1st to 99 at 15th and beyond (capture p. 33).
the hear noise column: 10 percent at 1st to 55 at 17th (capture p. 33).
the climb walls column: 85 percent at 1st to 99 at 15th and beyond (capture p. 33).
the surprise column as a code: 0 the normal 1st-level chance, then the surprised percentages 32 at 2nd down to 2 at 17th (capture p. 33).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 21 grid: the AC, movement, attack and damage codes, the six thief skills and the surprise ladder (capture p. 33)

table_checks.note: the T20 first row - 2,250 xp, two dice, Novice (capture p. 31)
the T20 capstone - 3,250,001 xp, eighteen dice, Grand Master of Flowers (capture p. 32)
the T21 first row - AC 10, move 15, normal surprise (capture p. 33)
the T21 capstone - AC -3, move 32, the 3/1 and +4D codes, 2 percent surprise (capture p. 33)
table_checks.expr: m['dghT21Ac'](16) != -3 or m['dghT21Move'](16) != 32 or m['dghT21At'](16) != 31 or m['dghT21Dmg'](16) != 400 or m['dghT21Surprise'](16) != 2

table_checks.note: the T21 attack codes open at 1/4 on the 4th-level row (capture p. 33)
the T21 damage codes open at +1D on the 8th-level row (capture p. 33)
the T21 thief-skill ladder - open locks 25 to 99, climb walls 85 to 99 (capture p. 33)
the ESP ladder - 30 at 4th minus 2 per level beyond, so 28 at 5th (capture p. 33)
the weapon damage step - one extra point per two levels (capture p. 32)
the heal ladder - 2-5 at 7th, one more per level beyond (capture p. 34)
the monastery supports three 8th-level monks and one of each level beyond (capture p. 35)
